name: Saya-san no Otetsudai
original_name: サヤさんのおてつだい
source: The protagonist, who suffers from an illness called “Doll Syndrome,” which causes their body to stop growing at the age of 1○, teams up with Saya, a researcher who can cure the illness. In order to cure their disease, the protagonist decides to “help Saya with her work…”
translation: 主人公患有一种名为“人偶综合症”的疾病，这种疾病会导致他的身体在1岁时就停止生长，他与能够治愈这种疾病的研究员沙耶合作。为了治愈他们的疾病，主角决定“帮助沙耶工作……”
